bio: Professor Fabiano “Índio” is a Jiu-Jitsu black belt with more than 20 years of experience and founder of Índio Jiu Jitsu Team school, affiliated with JA Índio Jiu Jitsu. He is also the creator of @indiodrills and one of the most respected professors in Brazil. Throughout his career, he has trained world, European, and Brazilian champions and is recognized as a reference in the gentle art. More than teaching techniques, Professor Índio passes on values of discipline, respect, and perseverance, changing his students on and off the mat. His mission is to share the knowledge that made him and his team stand out in Jiu-Jitsu, bringing high-quality technical content to practitioners around the world. Índio brings a clear, effective way of teaching that works for every body type. Don't wait — come train with us.
quote: "My job isn't just to teach techniques — it's to pass on the values of martial arts and help students face whatever life throws at them."
